Chapter 1073 16 Lin Yuan Tears The Sky (Vote For Monthly Pass)

Chapter 1073 16 Lin Yuan Tears the Sky (Vote for Monthly Pass)

"No wonder the Nine Profound Venerable cannot lock onto this Mysterious Space..."

Lin Yuan observed for a while, his expression thoughtful.

This Mysterious Space is deeply fused with space-time. Though it hasn't reached the level of the Demon Jade Space, achieving this level...

At the very least, one would need an understanding of the Ninth Realm of Space-Time.

The Ninth Realm of Space-Time is typically only accessible to the Chaos Great Saint. As for reaching the peak of the Ninth Realm? Even many peerless Great Saints might not be able to achieve it.

One of Xuanhuang's proudest feats is precisely his mastery over the peak of the Ninth Realm of Space-Time.

"This Mysterious Space must have been left by a Chaos Great Saint. Based on Cang Yulong's description, it's likely a site for inheritance."

Lin Yuan arrived at this conclusion in his mind.

"That Chaos Tree..."

Lin Yuan also noticed the Chaos Tree deep within the Mysterious Space, its swaying form emanating endless Chaos Qi.

"This move was worth it after all."

Lin Yuan was resolute.

Even if this inheritance space were not here, as long as he could obtain the Chaos Tree, provoking an enemy at the Venerable level would mean nothing.

Conflicts between Venerables are rare, mostly because there aren't treasures worthy of such battles. But the Chaos Tree? Just observing the Nine Profound Venerable's imprisonment of the Stone People Clan is revealing enough.

"Refining this space will take time; I'll deal with it after the duel."

Lin Yuan fixed the spatial coordinates of the inheritance space, ensuring that regardless of any relocation attempts by others, it could not escape him.

"You stay here for now."

Lin Yuan glanced at Cang Yulong.

In his duel with the Nine Profound Venerable, he would certainly need to merge his two Primordial Spirits into the Taiji Primordial Spirit. A single Primordial Spirit alone would hardly stand a chance.

While it's true that even if Lin Yuan lost, it wouldn't result in any significant loss...

Being defeated by the Nine Profound Venerable would carry a series of risks—for instance, it might give the Nine Profound Venerable the impression that Lin Yuan's strength was inferior to his, potentially prompting him to begin tracking Lin Yuan's movements after the duel.

Therefore.

When Lin Yuan faced off against the Nine Profound Venerable, victory would be the aim. Even if victory proved impossible, he would at least make the Nine Profound Venerable realize that Lin Yuan was no easy target.

As for leaving Cang Yulong here? Lin Yuan wasn't concerned about him trying to escape.

With the Mysterious Inheritance Space already acquired, the greatest opportunity had been secured. Cang Yulong no longer had a reason to flee.

...

Outside the Nine Profound Secret Realm.

Numerous gathering sites began migrating toward the interior of the secret realm.

The lifeforms inhabiting these gathering sites relied on the Nine Profound Venerable's protection. Each Cosmic Era, they would also offer up various treasures, including Chaos Stones, to the Nine Profound Venerable.

A Venerable's protection, of course, was not given freely.

The many "fragment worlds" outside the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent also required vast quantities of Chaos Stones to procure.

"What? The Nine Profound Venerable is going to duel another Venerable outside the secret realm?" The Nine Profound Venerable had not intentionally hidden the matter.

In truth, he couldn't have hidden it—even after the duel with Lin Yuan, the ripples of a battle between Venerables could not be concealed.

"The Nine Profound Venerable is dueling another Venerable? Which Venerable?"

"It doesn't matter which Venerable. Get into the secret realm quickly; if the duel begins while we're still outside, we won't be able to withstand the aftermath of their clash."

Outside the secret realm, the gathered experts were frantic. Even those at the Sovereign Realm felt their hearts tremble. To them, a duel between Venerables was an uncontrollable disaster.

"Alas, we may carry off the treasures, but the bases we've spent years constructing cannot be relocated quickly. Hopefully, something will still remain."

"Forget the bases. Surviving the ordeal would already be enough."

"Hurry into the secret realm! If we're any later, we might not make it in time."

Fortunately, the many subordinates of the Nine Profound Venerable were assisting with the evacuation. They even actively opened the defensive arrays outside the secret realm; otherwise, evacuation in mere half an hour would have been impossible.

"Still, who could the Nine Profound Venerable possibly have such a grievance with that a duel is necessary?"

"Indeed. We best not concern ourselves with the disputes of Venerables. Who knows what might happen if we do..."

The numerous clan experts engaged in hurried migration discussed the matter cautiously among themselves.

...

Outside the secret realm.

The Nine Profound Venerable had already been waiting for quite some time.

Rustling sounds filled the air.

A moment later.

Lin Yuan's figure quietly coalesced not far away.

At this moment, Lin Yuan's Taiyang and Taiyang had merged, forming the Taiji Primordial Spirit.

"Hmm?"

The Nine Profound Venerable frowned as he gazed at Lin Yuan. Now, Lin Yuan gave him a different impression—though the ferocious aura of burning the heavens and boiling the seas was gone, the Nine Profound Venerable's brow twitched, sensing an even greater threat.

"For someone capable of cultivating to the Chaos Realm, it's rare to be entirely unknown. And yet, I've never heard of you before..."

The Nine Profound Venerable stared at Lin Yuan, voicing his doubts.

He even began considering the Sovereign Realm peak experts he knew, suspecting Lin Yuan might have only recently ascended to the Chaos Realm. However, while the number of Sovereign Realm peak experts was significant, none of them matched Lin Yuan's description.

The trajectory of a powerhouse's growth is always traceable, especially for those who manage to ascend to the Chaos Realm. Before their ascension, it's impossible for them to leave no trace at all.

What the Nine Profound Venerable was unaware of, however, was that Lin Yuan was currently only at the Path Splitting Realm. The traces he left in the Chaos Void were minimal, and after leaving the cosmos, he had primarily remained in the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent.

Aside from Ancient Ming Venerable and the Eye of Myriad Laws detecting Lin Yuan's unusual nature, the outside world had no information about him whatsoever.

Thus, no matter how hard the Nine Profound Venerable tried to speculate, he could not discern Lin Yuan's true background.

"Hahaha, the Chaos Void is vast enough; what does it matter if one more Venerable appears?" Lin Yuan replied casually.

The Nine Profound Venerable, hearing this, did not fully agree, but he chose not to dwell on it. His focus now was entirely on defeating Lin Yuan.
